prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as another leader, the same in every cell: a Warden Captain of the Thornwood, a forest war leader: a helm of layered bark plates with a pair of antlers rising from it; a cloak of real overlapping green oak leaves over both shoulders and down the back to the knees; armour of layered bark plates over the chest and shoulders, with bark pauldrons; a deep bottle-green wool tunic under the bark (the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green), leather bracers, a broad leather belt and dark leather boots; weathered bark-brown skin and a short beard; a plain straight sword with a simple cross guard in the right hand. Where a figure of Image 1 holds the axe, this leader holds the sword in the same hand, pointing the same way. The leaf cloak replaces the fur mantle, the antlered bark helm replaces the spiked iron helm and the bark plates replace the iron. No fur, no spikes, no iron crown, no axe, no shield. Keep each figure's pose, size and position, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. This sheet is the body that each leader of this kind is later painted onto, so keep the kit plain: no personal ornaments, sigils or trophies. Painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette of bark brown, moss green, leather and bone; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right).

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the figures. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
